title: Syrian Lamb Koftas
description: A flavorful and gluten-free take on traditional Syrian lamb koftas, perfect for a quick dinner or lunch. These lamb koftas are marinated in a rich and zesty mixture, then baked to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the lamb, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small koftas, about 5cm (2 inches) in length. You should end up with around 12-15 koftas.
Place the koftas on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, leaving a little space between each one.
Brush the tops of the koftas with olive oil.
Bake the koftas in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through and lightly browned on the outside.
Remove the koftas from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
